Neetho | Neetho (English: "With You" ) is a 2002 Telugu romance film directed by John Mahendran, starring Prakash Kovelamudi and Mahek Chahal in their debut roles.  The story of this movie was readapted later for the Tamil movie "Sachein".

Sachein | Sachein is a 2005 Tamil romantic comedy film directed by John Mahendran starring Vijay and Genelia D'Souza, Bollywood actress Bipasha Basu in her Tamil cinema debut with Vadivelu, Santhanam and Raghuvaran appearing in supporting roles.  Based on the director's earlier Telugu film "Neetho" (2002), the film is produced by Kalaipuli S. Dhanu and has the score and soundtrack composed by Devi Sri Prasad.  The movie was released alongside Rajinikanth's "Chandramukhi" and Kamal Hassan starrer "Mumbai Express".  The movie released to positive reviews and was declared as a commercial success at the box office.
Nayee Padosan | Nayee Padosan (English: New Neighbour) is a 2003 Bollywood comedy film directed by cinematographer B.H. Tharun Kumar and starring Mahek Chahal, Vikas Kalantri, Anuj Sawhney and Aslam Khan in lead roles.  The movie is partially inspired the Tamil film "Indru Poi Naalai Vaa" and "Chashme Buddoor".  The movie was directorial debut for B.H Tharun Kumar and was a moderate success at the box office.
Simi Chahal | Simi Chahal, (b. 9 May, 1992) born "Simarpreet Kaur Chahal", is a Punjabi film actress from Ambala who predominantly works in Punjabi films. 
I Am Singh | I Am Singh is a 2011 Bollywood film which was released on 2 December 2011.  The film stars Gulzar Inder Chahal, Rizwan Haider and Puneet Issar who also directed the film and wrote the screenplay.  "I Am Singh" portrays the stories of Sikh immigrants in the US after the 9/11 attack.  The film highlights what happened to the immigrants and their fight against prejudice, never losing faith in the American judicial system.

The movie was directorial debut for B.H Tharun Kumar and was a moderate success at the box office.
Simi Chahal | Simi Chahal, (b. 9 May, 1992) born "Simarpreet Kaur Chahal", is a Punjabi film actress from Ambala who predominantly works in Punjabi films. 
Kranti Kanade | Kranti Kanade is a filmmaker from India.  His filmography includes "CRD", "Gandhi of The Month", "Mahek" and "Chaitra".  He studied at UCLA (University of California, Los Angeles) and FTII (Film and Television Institute of India).
Mahek | Mahek is an award winning Indian children's film by writer-director Kranti Kanade.
Gavie Chahal | Navdeepak Singh Chahal (Punjabi: ਨਵਦੀਪਕ ਸਿੰਘ ਚਾਹਲ ; 11 November 1978), commonly known as Gavie Chahal is an Punjabi Sikh actor from Mansa, Punjab.  He is known for his Hindi film debut in Yash Raj's 2012 film "Ek Tha Tiger".  He also featured in several notable Punjabi films which include "Yaaran Naal Baharan", "Mehendi Wale Hath", "Majajan" and "Tere Ishq Nachayva".
Arjan Singh Chahal | Sardar Bahadur Arjan Singh Chahal, CIE (1839–1908) was a Sikh Chahal Jat of Chahal village in Amritsar in what is now the Indian state of Punjab.  He was only seven when his father Bhai Javala Singh, died in 1846.
